claimPolicy: All appearance values, density labels, layer heights, glow caps and budget targets are authored assumptions. Only sources explicitly marked verified_principle establish researched facts. Images are AI concept references, not measured renderer or geography fixtures.

units.colour: sRGB hex decode to linear before mixing
units.strength: linear radiance blend weight unless specified
units.screen: CSS pixels at phone390x844; convert to drawable pixels by actual scale
units.darkening: percent linear base RGB relative to dry; not final shaded pixel

densityModel.VMeaning: Distance at which an ideal high-contrast object retains5% of its original contrast in this authored homogeneous model. Not a meteorological definition, fog end, guaranteed human seeing distance, or device depth precision.
densityModel.ordering: Surface lighting/contact/wetness -> one fog application in linear light -> shared exposure/grade/tone map. Apply no independent distance saturation/contrast fade or blur.
densityModel.liveVisibility: When valid weather visibility exists, use it as V. For V<=5m set nearClearM=min(5,0.1V) and sigma=ln(20)/max(0.01,V-nearClearM); valid visibility must be positive. Preserve raw observation separately; do not clamp densefog to60m. Reporting-limited high values remain lower bounds. Missing visibility plus explicitfog may use authoredmoderate220m fallback flaggedassumed; morning alone never selectsfog.
densityModel.infiniteRay: Sky uses path through supplied layer to exit, not infinite distance blindly; cap optical depth at12 before exponent.
densityModel.weatherCompatibility: Proposes replacing the weather-v1 stylized25/220 street and100/600 aerial fog start/end pair with one extinction policy. Do not multiply or apply both. Changes near-clear band to5m from legacy10m floor. Legacy adapter may keep existing fallback but cannot claim exact exponential parity.
densityModel.modeConsistency: Same environmental sigma/colour/layer across modes. Aerial rays above/shallowly through layer differ by physical path length, never arbitrary camera-specific larger visibility.

transition.method: smoothstep from frozen displayed endpoints; blend optical depth/sigma and linear colours once; retarget from current state

layers.baseReference: supplied ground/lake surface elevation; all demo heights assumptions
layers.profile: w(h)=1 for0<=h<=H-taper; linear decrease to0 across upper taper;0 aboveH. Belowground ignored. tau=sigma*integral w(h(s))ds over ray from nearClearM onward; T=exp(-tau). Linear height along ray allows exact piecewise polynomial integration, no raymarch. Scene horizontal domain supplied; clip layer to domain, not camera.
layers.domain: Baseline broad horizontal layer for flat testregion. Maximumone layer/domain; use existing loaded extent with boundaries beyondview, no hard visible box. Local lake-only density requires supplied domain and smooth boundary extinction; if unavailable use uniformlayer and flag it. Do not infer local densefog from OSMwater alone.
layers.skyAndWater: Use same integrated extinction for terrain/water/buildings/sky-to-layerexit. Aerial roofs/crowns abovetop are not whitened by opaque fog sheet. Water can receive stronger apparentveil through long shallow rays, not independent whiteoverlay.
layers.terrainLimitation: A single horizontal analytic layer is appropriate only to flat supplied testregions. Hilly terrain needs validated regional layers or uniformdistance fallback; no per-fragment terrain-following density solve required.

lightRules.solarExamples: Authored look examples, not capture event times. Runtime actual solar elevation/azimuth governs sun, shadows, glow and shafts.
lightRules.direct: Actual existing time-key sunstrength * min(1-0.6*cloudCover,fogDirectMultiplier); apply smoothstep(0,2,e) gate. Do not cloud*fog multiply. Proposedmoderate.35 lowfog replaces legacyfullfog.12 where thispreset selected; dense retains.12.
lightRules.sunGlow: Only e>0 and source-compatible cloud evidence: weight=strength*(1-Tsky)*exp(-ln(2)*(angle/12deg)^2) with smooth taper20–25deg. Mix Cfog toward sunFogHex, capstrength. No artificial disk or warm wash opposite sun.

shafts.gate: e2–10deg, rising branch, sun visible/cloudCover<.55, supportedfog, camera within35deg of sun. None atnight/overcast. Derive through actual canopy gaps, occlude behind real trunks/roofdepth; disable if depth-correct placement unavailable.
shafts.implementation: No volumetric raymarch or separate god-ray blurpass. Atmost2 soft analytic bands within existing depth-tested material/grade solution, else omit. Fixedworldsun alignment, no camera-facing movingcones.

shadows.length: height*cot(actuale); reduceddirect makes shadow faint not shorter

lamps.haloFormula: weight=haloMaxBlend*lampGate*4*Tlamp*(1-Tlamp)*exp(-ln(2)*(radius/rHalf)^2), taper to0 at28CSSpx. Lamphead surfacefog appliedonce; noextraT multiplication of head. Occlude halo center by scene depth; neverglow throughwall.
lamps.lampSchedule: Use supplied lampstate; demo gate by e ramps1 ate<=-2 to0 ate>=12. Schedule is authoredfallback, fog does not force lamp on atnoon.

surfaces.status: authored damp demo override; live surfacehistory authoritative
surfaces.dewPolicy: Broadsmooth grazing sheenonly; exposedupwardlawn, independent dew evidence/demo; no fog-to-dew causalassignment. Dawn alone not proof. Snow masks suppress sheen.
surfaces.precedence: Use rain-v1 damp row asone materialpolicy, neverstack on previousdarkening. Dew additive highlight cap.025, base lawnsheen.01 retained separately; combined capped.03.

sloansLake.status: concept based on existing engine paint-over geometry; not surveyed new camera
sloansLake.preferredDemo: shallow radiation/advection-type lowlayer, mechanism unknown withoutweather
sloansLake.oppositeBank: Fade by actualdistance; no silhouettefabrication or moving shoreline.

street.trees: Smoothroundedpuffs, thickbranchingtrunks/rootflare; nearshadevolume retained. No bark/leaftextures.

chicagoLakefront.status: generic new publiclakefront concept, not surveyedsite
chicagoLakefront.mechanism: Lake/advection fog is not lake-effect snow; steamfog only whencoldair/warmwater evidence exists

lifting.status: authored demonstration; live lifting requires updatedevidence
lifting.method: smoothstep sigma down, taper/top down and linearfogcolour towardlatemorning. Higher sun and shorter true shadows evolve fromactualtime, neveraccelerate solarposition withfogduration.

performance.mobileTest: PhysicaliPhone13class iOS26+, 60fps10min dawn/moderate/dense/lift street&aerial; logmaxandp95GPU andthermal. Same world/weathergeometry. No passclaimedfromconcept.

sources.scope: Extinction integrates along the ray; homogeneous transmittance is exponential. The stylized near-clear offset and contrast anchor are authored, not physical measurements.
Radiation fog develops near the cooling surface, can be patchy, favors sheltered and water-adjacent places, and commonly dissipates under sunlight. No fixed lifting time is established.
Warm moist air over cooler water can produce lake/advection fog, including the Great Lakes; it can move onto land. This does not verify a particular Chicago or Denver event.
